title: test role based authentication and authorization
description: Verify that role-based authentication and authorization work correctly for Admin, Vendor, and Supplier roles using JWT tokens and multi-factor authentication.

title: test user management crud operations
description: Validate full CRUD operations for user management including creating, reading, updating, and deleting users with role assignments.

title: test vendor and supplier registration and profile management
description: Ensure vendors and suppliers can register, update their profiles, manage contracts, and link vendor-supplier relationships correctly.

title: test inventory management and stock level tracking
description: Test inventory CRUD operations, stock level tracking, and real-time inventory reporting functionalities.

title: test order creation and tracking
description: Verify order creation, purchase order management, order tracking, and order history retrieval for vendors and suppliers.

title: test stripe payment processing and subscription management
description: Validate payment processing through Stripe, subscription plan activation for suppliers, and payment history tracking.

title: test ml forecasting and aws forecast integration
description: Ensure machine learning forecasting for demand, inventory, and cost predictions operate accurately and integrate with AWS Forecast.

title: test notification delivery and preferences
description: Test email and system notifications delivery respecting user preferences and customizable notification settings.

title: test reporting and analytics dashboards
description: Verify that dashboards display correct KPIs, transaction monitoring, activity logs, and custom reports for different user roles.

title: test file upload and aws s3 integration
description: Validate file upload functionality, AWS S3 storage integration, and file processing capabilities.
